## New
- **Public links for playlists:** a shared playlist now opens for anyone at musik.labtoso.de, no Tailscale and no home network needed. The link looks like `musik.labtoso.de/s/#…`. Songs from Spotify, Deezer and YouTube in a shared playlist play there too, found on YouTube Music like in the app
- **Invite collaborators from anywhere:** whoever opens an invitation link can make an account right on the page (or sign in) and lands in the playlist, ready to add and remove songs
- **Public links setting:** Settings → On the go → Public links shows the address, and you can change it or switch it off

## Safe by design
- Public links use a separate door of the server (port 8485, opened only by Tailscale Funnel on port 8443). Through it, first setup, updates, user management, folder scans and uploads are closed, admin accounts can't sign in, and sign-ins are limited to 20 a minute
- One invitation link makes at most 25 accounts

## Switch it on
Run the Proxmox script again and answer `y` to "Switch on public links?" (or `PUBLIC=1 bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Labtoso/Musik/main/deploy/proxmox.sh)"`). Docker and Windows: see the guide in `docs/tailscale.md`.

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script / `musik-update`)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new `Musik.exe`
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates, or `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
